nom: ANUA Heartleaf Low pH Deep Cleansing Water

avis.texte: Love this cleanser! It's gentle and does what it's supposed to do. I was so happy when I saw Anua made a cleansing water!

This product seems to work well enough to remove daily sunscreen and occasional makeup. I use as Step 1 in a double cleansing routine. I bought mine months ago and I still have plenty left. My eyes are pretty sensitive but if I expose them to an irritant bit by bit, they usually get used to the product over time. Not with this stuff! I absolutely dread taking my eye makeup off with this. It stings every single time. Sometimes my vision is a bit blurry afterwards which I think is more the dissolving makeup + product getting in my eyes more than anything. But my eyes feel red and irritated for a while after using this stuff. Won't be buying again but my skin likes it enough to keep using it until it's gone.
I love this cleansing water. I use it every morning and after oil cleansing in the evening. It's amazing how much it draws out of my pores. And no need to wash away!
I use this as a first clean in my double cleanse (im not a fan of oil cleansers) and i love this product. It works well, good value, and effectively removes makeup.
